scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @flower-survey/shared" "npm run dev -w @flower-survey/backend" "npm run dev -w @flower-survey/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @flower-survey/shared && npm run build -w @flower-survey/backend && npm run build -w @flower-survey/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @flower-survey/shared && npm run test -w @flower-survey/backend && npm run test -w @flower-survey/frontend
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n shared,backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run test:watch -w @flower-survey/shared" "npm run test:watch -w @flower-survey/backend" "npm run test:watch -w @flower-survey/frontend"
scripts.db:seed: npm run prisma:generate && node --import tsx prisma/seed.ts
